name: Review gate
what: Two fresh checkers per round, each with one lens, that see only the record, the work and what they link, never the conversation that made it. For a spec: paraphrase and zoom out; for a checkpoint: a critic and a code reviewer. Findings are Blocker, Major or Nit, each named by kind. The worker fixes, contests with evidence the checker could read, escalates what only you know, or declines a Nit. The gate passes on a clean round: no open Blocker or Major. Wherever it can, a finding becomes a new mechanical check.
when: the spec before Gate A, and every checkpoint; with a screen, the checkers also judge how it looks and behaves
